capabilities: Search the vault with ranked, typo-tolerant, prefix-matching fuzzy search
Search within the active note and jump to matches
Filter queries with exact phrases, exclusions, ext: and path: syntax
Index PDF, image (OCR), and Office files via the Text Extractor plugin
Persist the index in IndexedDB and re-index only changed files
extras: Manual install only: build from source with npm and copy dist files into the plugins folder. PDF/image/Office indexing is desktop-only and off by default with a warning when enabled. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No network requests are made; a optional 'Buy me a coffee' button links to buymeacoffee.com.
motivation: The author saw Omnisearch's slowness on large vaults as architectural — indexing, tokenization, and cache serialization all run on the UI thread — and restructured the same core idea around a Web Worker for performance.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search is not fuzzy or field-weighted, and Omnisearch indexes and searches on the UI thread, making it slow on large vaults.

relations.evidence: If you need an HTTP API, a public plugin API, embed results, or Chinese word segmentation, use Omnisearch
PDF / image (OCR) / Office indexing via the Text Extractor community plugin
the BM25 full-text search engine CFR Find runs inside its worker

summary: Fast worker-powered full-text search plugin with BM25 ranking, typo-tolerant fuzzy matching, in-file search, and optional PDF/image/Office indexing.
